Subject: Next steps: procurement signatory path & budget owner confirmation — Aurora Health

Hi Linda — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the procurement path: 

Call notes (high level):
- Use case: internal clinician decision support and summarization for non-PHI data.
- Target go-live: Q3 pilot (50 users).
- Key constraints: SOC2 evidence required, on-prem option considered but starting with Redwood hosted in a dedicated tenant.

Open procurement questions we discussed:
1) Preferred billing method: PO (monthly) vs. card (one-off) — you mentioned finance prefers POs for any contract > $50k/yr.
2) Signatory path: who signs (legal + finance + executive) for pilot-level commitments?
3) Budget owner / economic buyer: who owns the budget line and who is the finance sponsor?
4) Marketplace vs direct purchase: any preference for transacting via your health system marketplace (Mercato) vs direct vendor contract?

Proposed next steps:
- Linda: confirm budget owner name and finance sponsor (DUE Thu 5/20).
- Procurement (cced): confirm PO intake email and any required fields (PO number workflow, billing contact).
- Redwood (Ben/Priyom): attach an initial Mutual Action Plan and the baseline SLA + procurement checklist.

Attachments: Aurora-MAP-v1.pdf (draft MAP), Redwood-SLA-summary.pdf

If you prefer, we can prepare both a PO-ready quote and a card invoice — our pricing team can issue both.

Thanks — looking forward to the details so we can put the MAP on your calendar.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(t) 415-555-0123 | tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement signatory path & budget owner confirmation — Aurora Health

Hi Tessa — thanks for the tidy recap. A few answers from my side: 

- Budget owner / economic buyer: Dr. Marcus Hale (VP Clinical Informatics) — he owns the pilot funding and will be the exec sponsor.
- Finance sponsor: Priya Anand (Finance Manager, Clinical Ops). Priya handles PO validation and will sign off on budgets.
- Signatory: for pilot commitments <$75k we can have Director-level sign-off (Legal review by our contracts team still required). For anything >$75k we need SVP sign-off.
- Billing preference: Finance prefers PO for ongoing monthly billing. They will accept a card for one-off proofs-of-concept under $10k.
- Marketplace: we're open to purchasing through Mercato (our internal marketplace) if the vendor supports invoicing to Aurora Health. Could be easier for internal tracking.

CCing procurement for PO intake details.

Thanks,
Linda
Director, Clinical Programs
Aurora Health
linda.kim@aurorahealth.com

Hi Tessa / Linda — procurement here. Quick checklist and PO process items: 

Required fields on PO:
- Full legal vendor name and W-9 (we'll need your Redwood vendor profile).
- Line-item description, unit price, start/end dates.
- Billing contact: accounts-payable@aurorahealth.com
- PO submit method: upload to our Ariba portal OR email to procurement@aurorahealth.com with DOCX/PDF.

Timeline:
- Typical internal routing: Procurement -> Finance validation (Priya) -> Legal review (if terms deviate) -> Signatory. Expect 7–10 business days for standard templates.

For marketplace purchases (Mercato): please provide a marketplace SKU or contact Sarah Morales (mercato lead) and she can advise on merchant onboarding.
